summary.text: Allison Hougland is a Democrat and former Kansas state representative seeking to return to the Kansas House of Representatives, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican incumbent Lauren Bohi.
She represented District 15 from January 2023 to January 2025 and, in a Ballotpedia survey, described herself as a real estate agent and lifelong Olathe resident.

paragraphs.text: Allison Hougland earned a high school diploma from Olathe North High School and attended Johnson County Community College, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a realtor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her family has lived in Olathe since 1859 and that her father was a former state representative and judge.
Hougland defeated Republican Matt Bingesser in the November 2022 general election for District 15, taking office on January 9, 2023.
During the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Child Welfare and Foster Care, Elections, Legislative Modernization, and Welfare Reform committees.
She lost her 2024 re-election bid to Lauren Bohi, 50.7 percent to 49.3 percent, and left office on January 13, 2025.
In the survey, Hougland named the cost of living, including housing, groceries, utilities and child care, as a campaign priority.
